response.sql: WITH fielding_by_hand AS (SELECT p.bats as batting_hand, COUNT(*) as fielding_count FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, SUM(fielding_count) OVER () as total_count, AVG(fielding_count) OVER () as avg_count FROM fielding_by_hand) SELECT CASE WHEN batting_hand IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' ELSE batting_hand END as batting_hand, fielding_count as count, CAST(fielding_count AS FLOAT) / total_count as share, fielding_count - avg_count as above_average FROM totals WHERE fielding_count > avg_count ORDER BY fielding_count DESC
